name: GPT-6.1 Sol
desc: An upgraded version of GPT-6 Sol, offering near-Astra intelligence for agentic coding, computer use, and professional workflows at a significantly reduced cost. It demonstrates strong performance on tasks like DeepSWE and AutomationBench.

name: GPT-6 Astra
desc: OpenAI's most intelligent and aligned model to date, excelling in computer use, browsing, software engineering, cybersecurity, science, and professional work. It achieved high scores on FrontierMath Tier 4 (97.6%) and ExploitBench (100%).

name: Claude Opus 5.5
desc: The flagship model in the Claude 5.5 family, designed for complex work requiring careful judgment and agentic coding. It offers 40% lower running costs than its predecessor and excels in benchmarks like Terminal-Bench 4.0 (66.4%).

name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
desc: A faster, lower-cost model in the Claude 5.5 family, optimized for well-scoped everyday tasks, bug fixing, and document creation. It generates outputs over 30% faster and reduces per-task costs by up to 30% compared to Sonnet 5.

name: Claude Haiku 5.5
desc: The third and final addition to the Claude 5.5 family of models, designed for high-volume and cost-sensitive applications. It is expected to be released in the coming weeks.

name: Gemini 3.5 Ultra
desc: Google's upcoming flagship model, expected to be a direct competitor to GPT-5.7 and Fable 6. It leverages proprietary TPU v7 infrastructure and vast training data from Google and YouTube.

name: Muse Spark 1.3
desc: Meta's new flagship AI model, replacing the Llama series for powering chatbots and AI services. It brings frontier-level reasoning to complex coding and agentic workflows.

name: Grok 4.7
desc: xAI's flagship model for coding, long-running agents, and knowledge work. It offers a 500K token context window and supports configurable reasoning effort at multiple levels. Grok 4.7 was trained with a new, larger base model and an improved safeguard stack.

name: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash
desc: The latest and most efficient model in DeepSeek's new architecture family, featuring native multimodal visual understanding. It achieves strong performance on GPQA Diamond (90.9) and Terminal-Bench 2.1 (90.6), and is highly cost-effective.

name: Moonshot Kimi K3
desc: Moonshot AI's flagship, featuring 2.8 trillion parameters, making it the largest open-weights model released to date. Kimi K3 is natively multimodal with a 1-million-token context window.

name: MiniMax M3
desc: MiniMax's flagship open-weight model, combining frontier-level coding, a 1-million-token context window, and native multimodality (image and video input, desktop operation). It uses proprietary Sparse Attention (MSA) for efficiency.

name: Qwen 3.8 Max
desc: Alibaba's cloud-based flagship model, featuring a sparse mixture-of-experts architecture with ~95 billion active parameters and a 1-million-token context window. It supports native text, image, and video input.

name: Qwen 4
desc: Alibaba's next-generation model family, announced as 'in training' and expected 'very soon'. Public prediction markets suggest a launch before November 1, 2026.
note: Rumored release, expected very soon, as reported by Alibaba at Apsara conference and public prediction markets.

name: Mistral Medium 3.5
desc: A balanced frontier-class model combining reasoning, coding, agentic tool-use, and multimodal input. It is positioned for strong performance without the infrastructure demands of larger models.

name: GLM-6
desc: Zhipu AI's flagship model, featuring a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variant and smaller dense variants. It offers a 256,000 token context window and demonstrates strong gains in agentic tool-use and long-context retrieval.
